title: DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated September 8, 2026, relative to the Revolving Training Fund
text:
[3. CONSENT AGENDA ITEMS]
DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated September 8, 2026, relative to the Revolving Training Fund
  Semi-Annual Report: July 1, 2025 – June 30, 2026, as set forth.  [BPC #26-260]

  Recommendation(s) for Board action:

summary: Approves semi-annual report for Revolving Training Fund for period July 1, 2025 through June 30, 2026.
